🗓️ Aug 30, Sunday
🎾 Pickleball Only: 2–4 PM
🧘‍♀️Pilates + Pickleball: 3–5 PM
📍 North York, Toronto (exact address to be provided)

This is your sign to try a new side quest! 💅🏼

Come move, play, meet new people, and beat the Sunday scaries. 

You can choose your side quest: join us for pickleball only or start with a Pilates flow before hitting the courts for some pickleball fun! 🎾🧘‍♀️

Bring your besties or come solo — you’ll leave with a workout, new friends, and hopefully a new obsession! 💗

No pickleball experience needed; beginners welcome!
Paddles are available to rent for free.
title: 🎀Pickleball & Pilates
